metadata.description: a1h8's Claude Code plugins — KubeVerdict: anchor-by-render Kubernetes incident RCA (skill + MCP tools).

plugins.name: kube-verdict
plugins.description: Anchor-by-render root-cause analysis for Kubernetes incidents — compares what Git declares, what Helm applied and the live cluster, and turns each drift into a ranked structured diagnosis; an LLM, when configured, explains it. Local inference via Ollama by default; a remote provider receives the prompt.
